title: Negating Negatives: Alignment with Human Negative Samples via Distributional Dispreference Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the overall harmlessness of generated responses using safety-trained reward models (e.g., Beaver Cost) and GPT-4 as a judge, which is specifically instructed to penalize discrimination, prejudice, and socially biased content.
Qualitative case studies evaluating the model's ability to safely refuse adversarial prompts requesting racial slurs (e.g., anti-Mexican slurs) or racist words.
